summary: The v42 yellow dragon's acid breath reaches zap.c:zhitu's dual-wield off-hand corrosion gate. The C and JavaScript RNG streams match through step 83, but C prints 'Your wakizashi corrodes!' and waits at the final message page while JavaScript skips the effect. The missing callee is trap.c:acid_damage(uswapwep), represented in js/zap.js by note_unported('trap.c acid_damage').

mismatch.cObservation: The blast of acid hits you! The acid burns! Your wakizashi corrodes!--More--
cSourceCalls: zhitu(zap.c:4540) rn2(3)=1: main-hand acid_damage gate is false
zhitu(zap.c:4542) rn2(3)=0: off-hand acid_damage gate is true
mismatch.jsBehavior: js/zap.js:zhitu preserves the source rn2(3) gates but calls note_unported('trap.c acid_damage') for the selected off-hand object, so it omits erosion and the corrosion message.

source.branch: acid_damage returns on a null object or acid-resistant hero inventory; grease absorbs the effect; nonblank scrolls become blank paper; other objects are passed to erode_obj with ERODE_CORRODE and EF_GREASE|EF_VERBOSE.
callers: zap.c:zhitu calls acid_damage(uwep) and acid_damage(uswapwep) under distinct dual-wield probability gates; js/zap.js has matching unported calls.
zap.c:zhitm calls acid_damage(MON_WEP(mon)); js/zap.js has a matching unported call.
mhitu.c:passiveum calls acid_damage(MON_WEP(mtmp)); js/mhitu.js has a matching unported call.
mhitm.c:mhitm_ad_acid calls acid_damage(MON_WEP(magr)); js/mhitm.js has a matching unported call.
uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_acid also calls acid_damage(MON_WEP(mdef)); js/uhitm.js currently refuses the whole mhitm_ad_acid caller branch, so that call remains behind a documented unported boundary.
dependencies: trap.c:erode_obj is already implemented in js/trap_erode_obj.js, including the EF_GREASE and EF_VERBOSE behavior acid_damage needs.
zap.c:inventory_resistance_check is already implemented in js/zap.js.
The current one-screen defect is the skipped trap.c:acid_damage call from zap.c:zhitu; no RNG call is missing.

evidence: The saved queue SHA-256 is acd623dbdaf757c62d59919167f5997850d5e3316fb49e2782320882aa8695a9. It selected this case with one remaining screen at step 83.

The accepted evaluation at 990f9bc4c2964447a9adac4f0e54ea90728ee2cb reports 83/84 screens, 3005/3005 RNG values, and 83/84 cursors. The final C step records the off-hand rn2(3)=0 corrosion gate and the wakizashi message; JavaScript takes the same random branch but omits the helper's object effect.

Upstream trap.c:acid_damage at lines 4618-4653 explicitly protects carried objects only when inventory_resistance_check(AD_ACID) succeeds; otherwise it consumes grease, blanks eligible scrolls, or calls erode_obj(obj, NULL, ERODE_CORRODE, EF_GREASE|EF_VERBOSE). The existing JavaScript owner js/trap_erode_obj.js provides erode_obj and its inlined grease_protect branch.

A full source search found acid_damage callers at zap.c:zhitm, zap.c:zhitu (two object slots), mhitu.c:passiveum, mhitm.c:mhitm_ad_acid, and uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_acid. JavaScript has matching skipped calls in zap.js, mhitu.js, and mhitm.js; uhitm.js still refuses its whole mhitm_ad_acid branch and remains explicitly unported.
The existing v42 yellow-dragon acid-breath control reaches zhitu but misses the off-hand corrosion gate. It is not evidence for the dual-wield object effect exercised by this selected case.
